full_text: Let us examine the scaled dot-product attention formulation. The scaling factor square root of d_k prevents the dot products from growing excessively large in high dimensions, which would push softmax into regions with tiny gradients. Is multi-head attention executed in parallel across heads? Yes, each head projects queries, keys, and values into independent subspaces concurrently, then concatenates the outputs.
